.create materialized-view with (
     backfill=true,
     effectiveDateTime=datetime(2025-02-01)
) BikeAvailabilityByNeighborhood on table Raw_Bike
{
    Raw_Bike
    | summarize
        MinBikes = min(No_Bikes),
        MaxEmptyDocks = max(No_Empty_Docks)
        by BikepointID
}

BikeAvailabilityByNeighborhood

.create function with (docstring = "Gets all datapoints for a given BikepointID") 
 GetBikeDataByID(ID:string) {
    Raw_Bike
    | where BikepointID == ID
 }

GetBikeDataByID("BikePoints_763")
